cards.example_en: My grandfather still adds numbers quickly on a wooden abacus.
cards.example_zh: 我爷爷仍用一把木算盘快速做加法。

cards.example_en: My sister trains every evening at the music academy.
cards.example_zh: 我姐姐每天晚上都在音乐学院训练。

cards.example_en: I accidentally sent the message to the wrong classmate.
cards.example_zh: 我不小心把消息发给了别的同学。

cards.example_en: My aunt works as an accountant in a small office.
cards.example_zh: 我姑姑在一间小办公室里做会计。

cards.example_en: We circled every adjective on the weather worksheet.
cards.example_zh: 我们在天气练习纸上圈出了每一个形容词。

cards.example_en: We watched in admiration as she finished the marathon.
cards.example_zh: 她跑完马拉松时，我们都钦佩地看着。

cards.example_en: The advertiser paid the school team to wear those new shirts.
cards.example_zh: 广告商付钱让校队穿上那些新球衣。

cards.example_en: Advertising on the school website brought more visitors.
cards.example_zh: 学校网站上登的广告带来了更多访问者。

cards.example_en: Our aeroplane landed in Guangzhou just before the heavy rain.
cards.example_zh: 大雨来临前，我们的飞机降落在广州。

cards.example_en: We played basketball and went for noodles afterwards.
cards.example_zh: 我们打完篮球，后来去吃了面条。

cards.example_en: We visited an agricultural show and saw cows that won prizes.
cards.example_zh: 我们参观了农业展览，看到了获奖的牛。

cards.example_en: Alcoholic drinks were banned at the school leavers' party.
cards.example_zh: 学校毕业生聚会上禁止含酒精的饮料。

cards.example_en: The alphabet song helped my little brother learn letters.
cards.example_zh: 字母歌帮我弟弟学会了字母。

cards.example_en: Please put the library cards in alphabetical order before lunch.
cards.example_zh: 午饭前请把图书卡按字母顺序排好。

cards.example_en: The class list is arranged alphabetically by family name.
cards.example_zh: 班级名单按姓氏字母顺序排列。

cards.example_en: Street magicians amaze tourists near the shopping mall every weekend.
cards.example_zh: 每个周末，街头魔术师都在商场附近让游客大吃一惊。

cards.example_en: Grandpa told an amusing joke while we washed the dishes.
cards.example_zh: 我们洗碗时，爷爷讲了一个有趣的笑话。

cards.example_en: The announcement said the pool would close early.
cards.example_zh: 公告上说，游泳池会提前关闭。

cards.example_en: I do not take the late bus anymore because it is too slow.
cards.example_zh: 我不再坐那班晚班车了，因为它太慢。

cards.example_en: He offered an apology for breaking his sister's cup.
cards.example_zh: 他因为打碎了姐姐的杯子而道了歉。

cards.example_en: Loud applause filled the hall after the choir sang.
cards.example_zh: 合唱团唱完以后，大厅里响起了热烈的掌声。

cards.example_en: Arctic animals appear on the posters in our science corner.
cards.example_zh: 我们科学角的海报上有北极动物。

cards.example_en: Grandpa fell asleep in the armchair after lunch.
cards.example_zh: 午饭后，爷爷在扶手椅上睡着了。

cards.example_en: Nurses assist the doctor during the busy morning clinic.
cards.example_zh: 在忙碌的上午门诊里，护士协助医生。

cards.example_en: Our astronomy club meets on the roof when the sky is clear.
cards.example_zh: 天晴时，我们的天文社团在屋顶活动。

cards.example_en: The Great Wall is a famous attraction for visitors.
cards.example_zh: 长城对游客来说是著名的景点。

cards.example_en: Colourful birds flew around the large aviary in the city park.
cards.example_zh: 色彩鲜艳的鸟在城市公园的大鸟笼里飞来飞去。

cards.example_en: The bad-tempered dog barked at everyone who passed the gate.
cards.example_zh: 那只脾气坏的狗对每个经过大门的人都叫。

cards.example_en: My bald grandfather wears a cap when he works in the garden.
cards.example_zh: 我秃头的爷爷在花园干活时会戴帽子。

cards.example_en: She threaded a blue bead onto the bracelet for her sister.
cards.example_zh: 她把一颗蓝珠子穿到了给妹妹的手链上。

cards.example_en: A bright beam of sunlight came through the classroom window.
cards.example_zh: 一道明亮的阳光从教室窗户照了进来。

cards.example_en: The hungry dog seemed to beg for food by the table.
cards.example_zh: 那只饿狗好像在桌子旁边乞求食物。

cards.example_en: I ride my bicycle to school when the weather is fine.
cards.example_zh: 天气好的时候，我骑自行车去上学。

cards.example_en: Do not blink when the camera flash goes off for the photo.
cards.example_zh: 拍照闪光灯亮起时不要眨眼。

cards.example_en: The blond boy in the red jersey scored the winning goal.
cards.example_zh: 穿红球衣的金发男孩踢进了制胜一球。

cards.example_en: A tall bodyguard stood beside the singer at the concert gate.
cards.example_zh: 一名高个保镖站在演唱会门口歌手的身旁。

cards.example_en: I bought a dictionary at the bookshop near school.
cards.example_zh: 我在学校附近的书店买了一本词典。

cards.example_en: The boom of thunder shook the classroom windows.
cards.example_zh: 雷的轰鸣震动了教室的窗户。

cards.example_en: Chess needs brainpower, patience, and a quiet place to think.
cards.example_zh: 下棋需要脑力、耐心，以及一个安静的思考之处。

cards.example_en: She briefly checked the map before we left the metro station.
cards.example_zh: 离开地铁站前，她简短地看了看地图。

cards.example_en: Visitors can touch a bronze bell outside the history museum.
cards.example_zh: 游客可以触摸历史博物馆外面的一口青铜钟。

cards.example_en: A soap bubble floated over the playground and then burst.
cards.example_zh: 一个肥皂泡飘过操场，然后破了。

cards.example_en: Fill this bucket with water before you wash the car.
cards.example_zh: 洗车前先把这只桶装满水。

cards.example_en: A tiny bug landed on my sandwich during the picnic.
cards.example_zh: 野餐时，一只小虫子落在我的三明治上。

cards.example_en: The museum displays a bulletproof vest used by city police.
cards.example_zh: 博物馆展出一件市警察局用过的防弹背心。

cards.example_en: The water balloon will burst if you squeeze it too hard.
cards.example_zh: 你要是捏得太用力，水气球就会爆裂。

cards.example_en: Wait for me at the bus-stop opposite the sports centre.
cards.example_zh: 在体育中心对面的公共汽车站等我。

cards.example_en: Bye! See you tomorrow morning.
cards.example_zh: 再见！明天早上见。

cards.example_en: The worker repaired the cable after the storm.
cards.example_zh: 暴风雨过后，工人把电缆修好了。

cards.example_en: Check your calculation before you write the final answer.
cards.example_zh: 写下最终答案之前，先核对你的计算。

word.example_en: The attraction to the coast is obvious.
word.example_zh: 对海岸的吸引力显而易见。

word.example_en: The hall may burst into cheers.
word.example_zh: 大厅里可能突然发出欢呼。
